item.title: Mapletree sells US logistics portfolio for US$575 mil, acquires logistics facility in the Netherlands
item.description: Temasek-owned Mapletree Investments announced that it has sold a US industrial portfolio of about 4.43 million sq ft to EQT Real Estate for US$575 million. The transaction marks Mapletree’s fourth US warehouse portfolio divestment, following a total of US$691.1 million in logistics asset sales completed in 2025. Richard Prokup, CEO for the US at Mapletree, says the divestment reflects the execution of Mapletree’s closed-end fund strategy and highlights the strength of its US industrial platform.

item.title: Two-storey HDB shophouse at Bedok Reservoir up for sale at $4 mil
item.description: A two-storey HDB shophouse in the Bedok Reservoir area has been put up for sale via an expression of interest (EOI) with an asking price of $4 million. Located at Blk 631 Bedok Reservoir Road, the property has a combined gross floor area of 1,636 sq ft, reflecting a price of about $2,445 psf. A F&B restaurant occupies the ground floor with a strata area of about 743 sq ft, while the upper level offers residential quarters of 893 sq ft. item.title: New Placemaking Project Office to support Singapore's heritage businesses, enliven precincts
item.description: The National Heritage Board (NHB) will set up a Placemaking Project Office to enhance and protect Singapore’s historic districts, including Kampong Glam, Little India, and Chinatown. The new project office will work closely with key district stakeholders — such as the Kampong Gelam Association, Little India Shopkeepers & Heritage Association, and Chinatown Business Association — to better understand their needs and empower them to enliven their precincts and boost footfall. item.title: Banyan Tree revenue grows 35% on residences segment, net profit falls 7%
item.description: Singapore-listed global hospitality company Banyan Tree Holdings saw revenue rising 35% y-o-y to $271.3 million for the second half of 2025, while net profit declined by 7% to $33.5 million from a year earlier. The growth in group revenue was driven primarily by higher revenue recognition in its residences segment, but partially offset by softer performance in the hotel investments and fee-based segments. item.title: GuocoLand sells over 90% of River Modern on launch day at $3,266 psf
item.description: Singapore-listed developer GuocoLand sold 410 of the 455 units at River Modern on the project’s launch day on March 7, achieving an average price of $3,266 psf. Singaporeans and permanent residents accounted for nearly all the buyers, says GuocoLand.
